dimensions.right_sized: Each implementation work order represents roughly 500-1000 changed lines; estimates are directional, not a reason to invent filler work.
dimensions.component_focused: Each work order changes one cohesive component and preserves existing callers and behavior.
dimensions.interface_first: When work must be stacked, the shared interface is explicit and lands before work that consumes it.
dimensions.existing_work_aware: Completed and in-progress work is reused rather than recreated.

cases.description: A naturally right-sized additive change should remain one work order.

requirements: Add persisted retry scheduling to the webhook delivery component; implementation is expected to change about 700 lines
Existing webhook senders and payloads must continue to work without modification
evidence_requirements: Unit tests cover retry timing and the existing immediate-delivery path

rules: Prefer work orders of approximately 500-1000 changed lines
Keep a work order within one component
All changes must be backwards compatible

notes: Create one implementation work order, not separate tiny work orders for storage, scheduling, and tests
Require evidence for both new retry behavior and the unchanged delivery contract

cases.description: A large change should split at an interface and express the dependency direction.

requirements: Add a stable paginated audit-event reader interface in the audit component; expected change is about 600 lines
Add a CSV export implementation in the export component using that reader; expected change is about 800 lines
Existing audit queries and export formats must remain supported
evidence_requirements: An integration test exports multiple pages

rules: Prefer work orders of approximately 500-1000 changed lines
Keep a work order within one component
Define stable interfaces before dependent implementations
All changes must be backwards compatible

notes: Create separate audit-reader and CSV-export work orders
Make the export depend on the reader work order, never the reverse
Do not create a third coordination-only work order

cases.description: Closely related tiny edits should not be fragmented merely to mirror implementation steps.

requirements: Within the CLI presentation component, add a color preference, apply it to status output, and document it; the combined change is expected to be about 550 lines
Default output must remain byte-for-byte compatible when color is disabled or output is redirected
evidence_requirements: Snapshot tests cover default, color, and redirected output

rules: Prefer work orders of approximately 500-1000 changed lines
Keep a work order within one component
All changes must be backwards compatible

notes: Create one cohesive work order rather than preference, rendering, documentation, and test work orders
Preserve non-color output as an explicit acceptance condition

cases.description: A completed interface should be reused by the remaining dependent work.

requirements: Expose a backwards-compatible digest query interface
Implement email digest assembly in the mailer component; expected change is about 750 lines
evidence_requirements: Integration tests assemble a digest through the query interface

spec.name: Digest query interface
spec.objective: Add and contract-test the additive digest query interface in the notification component.
evidence_requirements: Contract tests cover old and new query clients

rules: Prefer work orders of approximately 500-1000 changed lines
Define stable interfaces before dependent implementations
Do not recreate completed or in-progress work

notes: Create only the mailer implementation work order
Do not cancel, supersede, or recreate the completed interface

cases.description: A tempting breaking shortcut should be rejected in favor of an additive boundary.

requirements: Add token metadata to the authentication component; expected change is about 650 lines
Some deployed clients still decode the version-one token shape and cannot migrate in lockstep
evidence_requirements: Compatibility tests prove version-one clients remain valid

rules: Prefer work orders of approximately 500-1000 changed lines
Keep a work order within one component
All changes must be backwards compatible

notes: Require an additive or versioned contract rather than replacing the version-one token shape
